summary: A mixed day across legal, retail and capital markets. Key developments include an NCLAT ruling on IBC resolution plans, a major promoter share sale at Granules India, and regulatory action by Maharashtra FDA on food safety.

bullets.text: NCLAT rules on whether IBC resolution plans survive death of their maker—setting precedent for insolvency proceedings.
Granules India promoter Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sells 1.72 crore shares worth Rs 1,500 crore to Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas.
Maharashtra FDA raids 11 food units in Thane, seizes Rs 20.48 lakh material under Tukaram Mundhe's oversight.
Decathlon India's B2B business grows 20-fold in five years, now represents 10% of overall revenue.
Reliance Industries to sell 5-year bonds next week, according to bankers.
